## INT Zone Studio · Pilot Evaluation Build v1

**Version:** `0.1.0-pilot.1`  
**Platform:** Windows 10/11 x64

### Download

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `INT Zone Studio Standalone Setup 0.1.0-pilot.1.exe` | Recommended — bundled engine, no Python required |

### Install

1. Run the setup executable.
2. Launch from Start Menu → **INT Zone Studio**.
3. See [Installation guide](https://github.com/Asish372/INT_Zone_Studio/blob/main/docs/manual/INSTALLATION.md).

### What's included

- DXF/DWG import and automatic pour-cell detection
- Suspected gaps + seed recovery
- Save/reopen workspace (`.pjson`)
- Export project package (PDF, DXF, CSV, Excel)

### Supported workflow

```
Import → Detection → Review → Recovery → Save → Reopen → Export
```
